    Team Members

    Sprints

    Following the Continuous Delivery model, our team has two week sprint cycles starting on Tuesdays and ending on Mondays.

    Meeting Schedule

    Listed below are the meetings our team holds throughout a sprint.

    Frequency What Why Who When Where
    Before Sprint Backlog Grooming Readies stories for sprint entry Product Team, Engr Manager, one Dev Mondays and Wednesdays, 11:30AM-12:30PM Team Focus Room
    Before Sprint Sprint planning Prepare for the upcoming sprint by ensuring team resources match up with sprint commitments Product Team, Engr Manager, one Dev Mondays and Wednesdays, 11:30AM-12:30PM Team Focus Room
    Sprint Start Sprint Planning Prepare for and commit to work in the next sprint Dev Team Every other Monday Air Velocity
    Sprint Start Sprint Review Demo work completed in the last sprint, identify wins, and areas for improvement Dev Team Every other Monday Air Velocity
    During Sprint Standup Vet and prioritize bugs Engineering Manager, Dev Leads, QE Leads, Product Daily 9:30AM-9:45AM Team area
    During Sprint Bug Scrubs Discuss yesterday’s and today’s work, impediments to work Dev Team Daily 9:45AM-10:00AM Team area
    After Sprint Release Readiness Discuss release with and get approval from stakeholders Program, Product, QA, Privacy, Legal, Security, Platform Per release schedule Slack
